android.desc:
Welcome to Colax — the ultimate campus marketplace and community platform built exclusively for students!

Colax makes it effortless to connect with your campus, buy and sell second-hand items, and stay informed about local updates.

Key Features:

Campus Marketplace: Buy and sell textbooks, electronics, furniture, and daily essentials with verified campus peers.

Community Feed: Share updates, post announcements, and engage with your campus network in real time.

Lost & Found: Report lost items or help return found belongings to students quickly.

Custom Profiles: Personalize your profile, showcase your listings, and track your activity.

Fast & Secure: Built with standard user authentication and data encryption to keep your interactions safe.

Download Colax today and start connecting with your campus community!
